column2: ENGLISH

For six hundred years the Empire has had no crowned Emperor, only rival claimants and the Electors who will not choose between them. Now the nobles speak your name in their halls, and the priests speak it from their pulpits. Your renown and your piety are known from the Reik to the Talabec. If you proclaim your claim, the Electors will have to answer it.
Proclaim it from every temple!
Not yet.
In a week you are crowned §YEmperor§!, and the §YHammer of Sigmar§! is yours if no one else holds it. A month later every independent Elector of the Empire must kneel to you or refuse.

The Grand Theogonist sets the crown upon your head before the high altar, and the cathedral rings with the hymns of Sigmar. Then he places in your hands Ghal Maraz, the Skull-Splitter, the hammer Sigmar himself carried, given to him by Kurgan Ironbeard of the Dawi. Outside, the bells of every temple in the city are ringing. Word goes out to the Electors: the Empire has an Emperor again.
For Sigmar and the Empire!

A herald stands in your hall with a letter under the seal of [From.GetTitledFirstName]. [From.GetSheHeCap] has been crowned [From.GetTitle], [From.GetSheHe] writes, by the will of the people and the blessing of the cults, and the division of the Empire is at an end. [From.GetSheHeCap] asks you to kneel and take your place among [From.GetHerHis] Electors.
Let the division end. I will kneel.
Never. I will not bend the knee to this usurper!
You put aside any rival Imperial crown, and your realm joins the §YEmpire§!.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] kneels before your throne and lays [From.GetHerHis] sword at your feet.\n\n"My liege, I ask you to forgive my part in the troubles. May a new age of unity and glory begin under your rule."
Well said. Rise, my Elector.
You have refused the false Emperor before your whole court. Not all your vassals were pleased to hear it. The softer-hearted among them say you have put your own crown before the Empire.
Bah, let them grumble!
[From.GetTitledFirstName] sends your herald back with a single answer:\n\n"I would rather see the Empire fall to ruin than kneel to you. I shall see you on the battlefield, usurper."
Traitor! The Electors' crowns are mine by right.
The [Root.Religion.GetName] Faith Triumphant

In 1359 IC Countess Ottilia of Talabecland refused to recognise the elected Emperor, the Count of Stirland, saying the election had been rigged by the Cult of Sigmar. She crowned herself Empress with the Cult of Ulric behind her and named Sigmar a false god. Ever since, each of the great cults has backed a claimant of its own.\n\n[Root.GetTitledFirstName] has ended it. The [Root.Religion.GetName] faith is now the state cult of the Empire, and the others stand beneath it.
Praise [Root.Religion.GetHighGodName]!
The [From.Religion.GetName] Faith Triumphant

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has made the [From.Religion.GetName] faith the state cult of the Empire and set the other cults beneath it. Priests of the triumphant faith are already at your gates, asking whether you will come to its altars.
Praise [From.Religion.GetHighGodName]!
I will keep the faith of my fathers.
The Peace of the Cults

Since 1359 IC the cults of Sigmar, Ulric and Taal have fought for mastery of the Empire, each with a claimant of its own. The Vampire Wars have humbled them all. If they do not stand together now, the dead will take what is left. The Grand Theogonist has called for peace among the cults, and their faithful may marry one another again.

Since 1359 IC the cults of Sigmar, Ulric and Taal have fought for mastery of the Empire, each with a claimant of its own. Now a Black Crusade marches out of the north, and the Empire must stand together or burn. The Grand Theogonist has called for peace among the cults, and their faithful may marry one another again.

Since 1359 IC the cults of Sigmar, Ulric and Taal have fought for mastery of the Empire, each with a claimant of its own. The Grand Theogonist has called for peace among them, and their faithful may marry one another again. Not every priest is pleased. Some say the peace is a surrender.
Let there be peace among the faithful.
We must stop this threat at any cost. Send envoys to our rivals and the Dawi.
We must stop this threat at any cost. Plead with Bretonnia.
There will be no peace with heretics.
Trouble in the Empire

An envoy of [From.GetTitledFirstName] has come to your court. The dead are on the march in the Empire, the envoy says, and if the Imperial lines break they will not stop at its borders. [From.GetSheHeCap] asks for an alliance. Your advisors urge you to accept, before the war comes to you.

An envoy of [From.GetTitledFirstName], your rival for the Imperial throne, has come to your court asking for an alliance against the undead that threaten you both. Your advisors remind you that if you win the war together, the rivalry will go on after it. Perhaps it would be wiser to let [From.GetHerHim] fend for [From.GetHerselfHimself].

An envoy of [From.GetTitledFirstName] has come to your court. A Black Crusade marches on the Empire, the envoy says, and if the Empire falls the hordes will not stop at its borders. [From.GetSheHeCap] asks for an alliance against the Ruinous Powers.
I accept this treaty.
I shall decline.
The Imperial Throne

In 1979 IC the Grand Theogonist of Sigmar refused to crown Magritta of Marienburg, though the Electors had chosen her. It ended the election of Emperors and threw the Empire into strife. [This.GetTitledFirstName] means to right that wrong and press [This.GetHerHis] claim, but reports are coming in of dark rituals in Sylvania.

In 1979 IC the Grand Theogonist of Sigmar rightly refused to crown Magritta of Marienburg Empress. It ended the election of Emperors and threw the Empire into strife. [This.GetTitledFirstName] means to press [This.GetHerHis] own claim to the throne, but reports are coming in of dark rituals in Sylvania.
The Empire is mine, by right.
The vampire threat comes first.
